steps.title: Open the Desk and find the Playbook
steps.narration: The Desk page is where the playbook lives. This round changed nothing about how it works — it re-checked that the Claude-facing read tools still match what the page shows, and recorded a replay script so that check runs automatically from now on.
steps.point_out: The Playbook Signals panel, where a recorded session is scanned for the book's setups.

steps.title: The evidence table names the exact recipe it was built from
steps.narration: Further down, the Playbook Evidence table states the signature it pooled its numbers from. That line is the thing this round pinned: it is a fixed label the page always renders, so the new replay script checks it rather than the changing code beside it.
steps.point_out: The 'Built from signature:' line above the evidence table.

steps.title: A date the calendar does not have is refused in plain words
steps.narration: Typing something that is not a real day does not start a scan. The page says what it wants instead, and marks the field invalid for screen readers.
steps.point_out: The message under the date box explaining what a valid entry looks like.

expect.text: or leave it blank for the most recent recorded session

steps.title: A real session date clears the refusal
steps.narration: Put in a day that was actually recorded and the message goes away, leaving the scan ready to run.
steps.point_out: The message disappears once the date is a real one.

steps.title: Everything the Desk already did still works
steps.narration: The rest of the Desk is untouched — the run ledgers from earlier chapters are still on the page exactly as they were. Nothing shipped this round, and nothing broke.
steps.point_out: The Screen Runs ledger, one of the kept sections carried in from the earlier Desk work.
